# Khronos API headers

`include/GL/glcorearb.h` is vendored unchanged from OpenGL-Registry commit
`9cb90ca4902d588bef3c830fbb1da484893bd5fb`:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenGL-Registry/blob/9cb90ca4902d588bef3c830fbb1da484893bd5fb/api/GL/glcorearb.h

Its SPDX license is MIT; the full notice is in `licenses/khronos-opengl.txt`
at the project root. `include/KHR/khrplatform.h` retains its embedded Khronos
permission notice (also copied to `licenses/khronos-platform.txt`).
The platform header was retained from the previously vendored dependency;
its header identifies upstream semantic revision
`67a3e0864c2d75ea5287b9f3d2eb74a745936692` in EGL-Registry.

The project's loader is in `gl/`. These headers supply API declarations only.
